region_rules.staff_head: Square side 0.22*H centered at track.tip_xy shifted upward by 0.06*H. Use non-null frozen tip literally.
region_rules.staff_head_null_fallback: Topmost base alpha>=128 point outside head box; not used (all tips non-null).
region_rules.pauldron: Screen-right shoulder: x=[bbox center-x,bbox right+12], y=[head_top_y+0.10*H,head_top_y+0.34*H].
region_rules.box_integer_conversion: Floor lower bounds, ceil upper bounds, clip to [0,512]; upper bounds exclusive.
region_rules.tracking: Frozen video_cut.track over full ordered base-alpha sequence; native coordinates; frozen 3-frame median head_top_y.

drift_definition: Sum over pixels outside BOTH declared boxes of max(base_alpha,variant_alpha)/255 * mean_c(abs(base_RGB-variant_RGB)), divided by sum of the same alpha-union weights. Straight RGB; 0..255. Includes inverse-sheet resampling/matte differences; no baseline correction.
silhouette64_definition: Frozen distance(base alpha, variant alpha); 1 minus centroid/area-aligned IoU on frozen 64px silhouettes.

matte.method: green excess matte + inverse straight-alpha compositing + nearest fully-opaque RGB clamp
